name: Chicken Piccata Skillet (Low-Carb Lemon-Caper)
note: Pan-seared breast + lemon-caper pan sauce, same skillet, no starch. Distinct sauce/flavor family from every accepted chicken skillet: marsala (marsala-mushroom), creamy-tuscan (sun-dried-tomato cream), french-fricassee (white-wine velvet cream) - only the pan-seared-breast method is shared, and piccata's bright lemon-caper profile is an open niche the catalog lacks. Cross-lane checked against fresh accepted-slugs.json: no piccata of any protein accepted. Carries capers as a pricer-lane flag. Cross-protein note (not resolved): pork/turkey/veal piccata would be the same dish minus protein - future-lane merge concern only; none accepted.
